description: Saves a version of an HTML prototype (a page, screen or flow) in .hexagen/prototypes/<name>/ and returns a local preview URL to show the user. Search the UI rules first (search_knowledge_base "ui conventions"). Pass the full page as html, or edits (exact oldText → newText) to change the current version. Static UI rules run on every save; run_quality_assurance with checks ["ui"] adds the browser check (phone/desktop, light/dark, screenshots). Each version is a checkpoint.

agent.description: The agent role making this call (e.g. "dev", "qa", "e2e"), so its work is attributed to it. Defaults to HEXACORE_AGENT.

basedOn.description: Version to start from (default: the current one)

edits.description: Changes to the base version instead of html; each oldText must appear exactly once

files.description: Extra text files next to index.html (styles.css, app.js…)

html.description: The full page (a complete HTML document with its own <style>)

target.description: Where it should end up, e.g. docs/index.html or src/features/landing

name: create_prototype
title: Create or update a UI prototype
